Card Q&A.a: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?

a: This effect prevents [When Digivolving] and [When Attacking] effects on cards from activating.
[When Digivolving] effects and [When Attacking] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.
Card Q&A.q: What does "can't activate [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effects" mean, exactly?

a: The effect can activate if it activates upon the [End of Attack] timing.
q: I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effects" to attack.
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] effect at such times?

Card Q&A.q: If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effects?
If a card is given "can't activate [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effects," can I process just the "by" condition for its [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effect?

a: The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].
q: A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] or [When Attacking] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] effect.
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
